script_text: Stop, Taurus—the cardinal cross is tightening, and calm is not safety. Your fixed Earth element needs steady ground, but the Sun near 6° Libra in your 6th House squares Venus, your actual ruling planet, near 4° Aries in your 12th House. Venus conjuncts Neptune at 3° Aries and nears conjunction with Saturn near 11°, tightening hidden feelings and shared costs. Venus in your 12th House can draw a guarded yet loyal connection through private chats or online introductions. If attached, expect temporary distance; ask what happened instead of chasing silent signals. Your 6th House of Work and 12th House of Hidden Costs activate: audit invoices, payroll deductions, subscriptions, and reimbursement receipts. Choose a quiet review over an impulsive purchase or expensive lunch. Avoid lending on charm alone; Saturn’s pressure makes today’s financial boundaries nonnegotiable. Follow for tomorrow, and subscribe so you don’t miss this week’s shift.
